data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT export to the llm-review job in ci.yml. Add a smoke-test CI step that pipes a representative diff through review-complexity-classifier.sh and asserts exit 0 + parseable JSON. Once smoke-test passes in main CI, remove classifier.py atomically.
**Why**: CI parity (SC2): use the same classifier as local. classifier.py is the weak Python implementation that the bash classifier supersedes.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - ci.yml exports CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT pointing at the checked-out plugin tree
  - Smoke-test step runs review-complexity-classifier.sh on a fixture diff and validates output
  - classifier.py removed in the same commit that activates the bash classifier in dispatch.py
  OUT:
  - dispatch.py loading of agent files (S1)
  - Overlay logic (S3)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CI uses review-complexity-classifier.sh end-to-end; classifier.py has been removed
  ← Satisfies: "Single source of truth for review prompts (CI parity)"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Smoke-test must pass before classifier.py removal commit lands; rollback path is restoring classifier.py if smoke-test regresses

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a CI workflow, I have CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT bootstrapped and review-complexity-classifier.sh validated before classifier.py is removed
